idea: Risograph printing: a lavender-milk ground, plum ink and the slight misregistration of a second pass. Soft without being weak, the inks are saturated and only the ground is pale, and every corner is round. Things behave like stickers, a flat shadow beside them, a small lift askew under the pointer, pressed flat, and move with a springy overshoot nothing else in the package has.

loadBearing.claim: The ground is tinted, not white: a lavender so pale it reads as white until white is put beside it.
Plum acts; mint and violet are fills, never actions.
The overprint: the headline carries a second-pass duplicate held 2px off register.
Soft geometry: the largest radii in the package, and a rounded clip on the hero.
The springy overshoot drives every arrival, fill, lift and press.

colourRoles.use: The page ground, a field's ground, the alarm's ground.
colourRoles.never: White; white is the card laid on it.

colourRoles.use: Cards, every panel, the navbar, the spec sheet, a platform chip: raised reads as cleaner, not lighter.
Text, and the hue of every soft shadow.
colourRoles.never: Pure black, which only the stamp's ink is.

colourRoles.use: What acts and what marks: the primary button, the call to action, the current page, the selected tab, the microlabel, the drawn rule, the pearls; mixed with black, the sticker's shadow.
colourRoles.never: A pale fill; it is an ink, not a tint.

colourRoles.use: The plate that fills in behind a marked word, and a hovered menu row.
colourRoles.never: A selected state: it reads 1.14 against the ground.

colourRoles.use: Words on the mint plate, and the pearls of the alt divider.
The second marked phrase of a lede: the other drum of the two-tone print.
colourRoles.never: A third fill beside mint and violet.

colourRoles.use: A field's edge, a ghost button's edge, every panel's frame, and the halftone's dots.
The destructive button, an invalid field, an error, the alarm's headline.
colourRoles.never: Without words beside it: it is the theme's colour closest to its primary.

colourRoles.use: The stamp only: mint's own hue, darkened, with black ink on it.
The headline's duplicate layer, at 55 % and multiplied.
colourRoles.never: Running text: doubled edges are unreadable for someone with astigmatism.

type.description: Instrument Sans, the same face as the body, bold and balanced to 22ch; the overprint, not a second face, makes it a headline.
Instrument Sans; buttons at 0.92rem and 600, labels in the ink at 600.

type.tracking: 0.22em on a microlabel, 0.12em on the stamp
type.description: The system mono for the small print: microlabels in plum capitals, the stamp, the brand tag, the language link, identifiers and the platforms.

radius.description: 1rem by token; the register goes further: cards 1.2rem, panels 1.1rem, buttons 0.85rem, fields 0.65rem, badges 0.5rem, and the progress bar and the band are pills.

borders.description: Hairlines of --border on cards, tables and the navbar; the stronger boundary on fields, ghost buttons and every floating panel; dashed for an empty state and a read-only field.

shadows.description: Two kinds, never mixed up: the sticker's hard offset (0 3px 0, plum mixed 45 % with black, no blur) on buttons and back to top, and a soft plum-hued drop under floating panels (0 24px 48px at 25 %).

signature.description: The sticker: a control sits on the page with a flat shadow beside it, and the current side navigation row is peeled down at -1.4deg. The hero's bottom corners round off by 2.5rem.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.description: The same milk as the page, with its bottom corners rounded off, one column, the overprinted headline.

surfaces.name: app
surfaces.description: Milk with white cards on it, and a halftone raster of six-pixel dots at 5 % over the whole page.

surfaces.name: footer
surfaces.description: A slightly deeper lavender under a hairline, spaced capital headings in the muted ink.

flicker.reason: Soft is the point: nothing here loops or opposes its own direction, and the spring is the only drama.

enter.description: A plate fills in behind a marked word: the mint plate grows from the left with the overshoot, and the second phrase fills violet after it.
enter.note: The dialog declares a transition (opacity, transform, 180ms) but nothing changes either when it opens, so it has no visible entrance; see the recipe.

leave.description: A redaction lifts: the ink plate over each phrase fades while it narrows back toward the phrase's start, 90ms apart; the word appears only where the plate has gone.
leave.duration: 220ms fade and 380ms narrowing per phrase, 90ms apart
leave.easing: ease for the fade, --fx-ease for the narrowing
leave.note: No component leaves with motion; see the recipe.

press.description: Pressed flat: the sticker sinks 3px, straightens and loses its shadow; a primary or destructive fill steps to its pressed token; an icon button settles to 98 %.
press.reducedMotion: The button sinks flat at once; the icon button does not scale.

hover.description: The sticker lifts: up 2px and askew by -1.2deg, its hard shadow growing to 5px with a soft drop under it, overshooting into place.
hover.reducedMotion: No lift and no tilt, because the lift itself sits inside the motion guard; only the fill colour changes.

load.description: The second pass springs into register: the headline's duplicate flies in from a wide misregistration to its 2px rest offset, once; a section rule grows left to right when it enters the view.
load.reducedMotion: The duplicate rests at its 2px offset and the rule stands drawn.

attention.description: A sticker slapped on a risograph sheet. The milk plate fades in; the paper panel lands the way a hovered sticker lifts, from 6px up and -1.2deg askew to rest, overshooting; the mint plate fills in behind the code line; the headline's second pass springs from a wide misregistration into its 2px rest. Nothing loops or flickers.
attention.duration: --fx-duration plate; 420ms landing; 420ms fill after 300ms; 650ms overprint after 200ms
attention.easing: --fx-ease, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); plain ease for the fades
attention.reducedMotion: The landed panel, the full mint plate and the overprint at rest 2px off register, at once.
attention.note: The alarm's colours keep their roles: the milk ground, plum pearls on the seams, a paper panel with the boundary frame and the soft plum drop, the danger red headline, plum ink, a plum sticker button.

ornaments.name: Pearls
ornaments.where: [data-kp-divider]; the alt divider before the footer.
ornaments.description: Round beads on a 2px thread, spread so no bead is ever cut; plum on the plain divider, mint ink on the alt one, so the two seams read as two sheets.

ornaments.name: The overprint
ornaments.where: The headline marked [data-kp-reveal='headline'], and nowhere else.
ornaments.description: A sky-blue duplicate of the words at 55 %, multiplied, 2px down and right.

ornaments.name: The sticker
ornaments.where: Buttons, back to top, the current side navigation row.
ornaments.description: A hard, unblurred offset in plum mixed with black, beside the control rather than under it.

ornaments.name: The stamp
ornaments.where: A card with a label; on the dossier, it swaps its word when opened.
ornaments.description: A darkened mint plate with black mono capitals, rotated -3deg, 0.4rem round.

ornaments.name: The rounded hero
ornaments.description: The hero's bottom corners clip round by 2.5rem, so the opening surface reads as a sheet laid over the page.

ornaments.name: The pill band
ornaments.description: A rounded pill on the card colour, inset from the page edges.

ornaments.name: Halftone
ornaments.where: The page's texture layer, over everything.
ornaments.description: Six-pixel dots in the boundary ink at 5 %, where the theme once had noise.

voice.case: Sentence case everywhere; spaced mono capitals only for the microlabel, the brand tag, the stamp and footer headings.
labels: A microlabel is a plum mono tick in spaced capitals.
A field label is the ink at weight 600, with no prefix.
A dropdown link carries a small ' ▾'.
The stamp swaps its word when the file is opened (the consumer's label and label-open).
voice.icons: Type does the work: a ' ▾' after a dropdown link, round status dots, no drawn glyphs of its own.
neverDoes: More than three inks at once.
A redaction left covered on a page with no script.
A sharp corner or a flicker.

recipe.answer: The alarm as a sticker on the milk ground: pearls on the seams, a paper panel that lands askew and overshoots into place, the danger red headline with its overprint springing into register, a mint plate filling in behind the code line, the plum sticker button; nothing flickers.
A rounded plate: the plain alert on the muted ground with a hairline, severity toasts on white panels with the soft drop, badges 0.5rem round; the words say which severity.
The sticker button: plum for the primary action, sky for the secondary; lifts askew on hover, pressed flat.
The sticker lifts; a menu row fills mint; a table row takes the muted ground; a side navigation link rises 1px.
The package's fade, on a raised white card 0.8rem round with a soft plum drop.
No visible entrance: the dialog's declared transition has no starting style to move from.
recipe.proposal: Give the transition the register already declares a starting style: opacity 0, 8px lower and -1deg askew, springing to rest over 180ms on --fx-ease; nothing under reduced motion.

recipe.answer: No exit today: the panel is gone at once.
recipe.proposal: The sticker peels off: opacity to 0 while it rises 4px and turns 1.2deg, over --fx-duration on --fx-ease.

recipe.answer: A pill progress bar on the muted ground, a rounded skeleton, a spinner with a plum head.
Pearls; before the footer, the pearls in mint ink.

recipe.situation: Mark what matters in a sentence
recipe.answer: A mint plate filled in behind the phrase; a second phrase in violet.

banner.description: A banner that asks for attention, from existing parts only: a white card with a plum mono tick, the destructive alert whose word 'Warning:' carries the meaning, the key phrase filled in mint, the plum sticker button beside the ghost one, and a string of pearls under it.
